history.text: Portuguese traders built Elmina Castle, the first European fort in the tropics.
The Asante empire dominated the interior from Kumasi.
Britain established the Gold Coast colony after a series of Anglo-Asante wars.
Independence came on 6 March, the first in sub-Saharan Africa, under Kwame Nkrumah.
A new constitution restored multi-party rule after military governments.

worthSeeing.title: Cape Coast and Elmina castles:
worthSeeing.text: Slave-trade forts on the Atlantic, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Kumasi:
worthSeeing.text: The Asante capital, with the Manhyia Palace and the Kejetia market.

worthSeeing.title: Mole National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Northern savannah park where elephants come to the waterholes.
